canonical_audio_invariant.reason: Reference cancellation can distort spectral and phonetic evidence.

target_alignment_policy.OMITTED: Completeness only; never forced into phone alignment or penalized again
target_alignment_policy.INSERTED: stored separately; excluded from target pronunciation accuracy
target_alignment_policy.SUBSTITUTED_OR_UNCERTAIN: low-confidence/uncertain; no exact phoneme claim without dedicated evidence

candidates.role: intelligibility/recognition baseline, not a true pronunciation model
candidates.prohibited_claim: ASR mismatch is a confirmed pronunciation error

candidates.selection_rule: validate against teacher Pronunciation labels; raw 0-100 score is not ground truth

candidates.decision: Existing selected-ASR word timing is sufficient to gate matched words for the first benchmark.
candidates.reconsider_if: Dedicated backend fails because materially better word/phone boundaries are required.
candidates.preferred_future_option: WhisperX alignment only; do not replace validated small.en ASR without evidence.

candidates.reason: Optional research benchmark with Kaldi/GOP/Windows integration cost disproportionate to the two-week MVP.

models: isotonic for one monotonic score if justified

construct_separation.pronunciation: accuracy/clarity of speech sounds and words
construct_separation.intelligibility: ease of listener understanding without transcript
